messages:
maya: Quick sync — Legal and Sales want a phased-commit option for large pilots (so customers can ramp to full commit over 3 months). Asking: how do we map phasing to tiering, addon eligibility, and SLA tiers?
raj: +1, saw the note. Main constraint: Dedicated capacity reservations assume monthly commit. Phasing implies we need a temporary 'pilot queue' or burst buffer.
katie: What about a time-limited 'pilot credit' that converts into commit credit if they sign? That would avoid carveouts in the core product.
liam: Engineering: pilot queue is doable but expensive to isolate. Cheaper approach = soft-priority routing with capped qps per account and automatic fallback to hosted non-dedicated.
maya: Sales wants predictable performance for pilots because product demos are sensitive to perf. They'd pay for an addon if it guarantees throughput for 90 days.
samir-bizdev: From GTM — customers accept a short-term surcharge for guaranteed capacity. We could offer a "Pilot SLA addon" (30/60/90-day options) priced as X% of equivalent reserved capacity.
katie: Need launch criteria: 1) billing flow for addon, 2) routing rule in console, 3) docs and contract language (auto-convert or refund).
liam: Ops note: we'll need a graceful eviction policy if capacity is oversubscribed. Proposal: priority weight -> burst buffer -> degrade to compatible model variant.
maya: Also confirm what counts as "eligible addon" — only customers with >$Y M ARR or any self-serve? Sales wants to sell to enterprise mostly.
raj: Suggest gating addon eligibility behind committed or Sales-approved pilots. Prevent small self-serve signups from consuming reserved pools.
samir-bizdev: Agreed. Pricing suggestion: flat addon fee + usage surcharge while pilot active. Convert surcharge into credit if they commit within N days.
katie: For product roadmap: add card to Q2 initiative list: pilot-addon spec, billing workflow, console toggle, contract template. Owners: katie (spec), liam (routing/ops), legal for contract text.
liam: Technical constraints we must call out in spec: - max simultaneous pilot add-ons per pool - model-variant fallback mapping table - monitoring alerts for pilot buffer saturation
maya: Can we validate capacity cost with a small internal pilot? Ops could simulate N concurrent pilots and report per-token cost delta.
liam: Yes, put a capacity-sim run on eng backlog and schedule a short benchmark. I'll add the ticket.
samir-bizdev: Timeline ask from Sales: pilot-addon should be shippable as a private beta in 6 weeks, GA in 12. Is that realistic?
katie: Tight but doable if we scope the beta to a single region and a single model family. We'll keep automation minimal for beta (manual provisioning).
raj: Contractually, Legal wants an auto-convert opt-in checkbox and a clear cancellation refund formula. We'll need wording for "pilot credits" and expiration.
maya: Action items: katie write spec draft by EOD Friday; liam create ops simulation ticket; samir prepare pricing kite (3 price points); raj loop in legal for terms.
liam: ops-bot: created ticket INF-4217 "pilot buffer sim" for benchmarking.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-4217 created and assigned to liam. ETA: 2 weeks.
maya: Great — we'll reconvene next Tue to review spec draft. :calendar: 
raj: I'll prep a short risks note for execs (capacity leakage, resale risk, SLA overpromising).
katie: Thanks all — I'll push the draft to the pricing workspace and tag this thread. :thumbsup:
